mapper.sql: act13_real_account_map_id AS real_account_map_id , act13_company_id AS company_id , act13_repr_account_cd AS repr_account_code , act10_repr_account_nm AS repr_account_name , act13_account_map AS account_map , act13_real_account_cd AS real_account_code , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||act01_account_nm AS real_account_name , act13_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM act13_real_account_map INNER JOIN act10_repr_account ON (act10_company_id = act13_company_id AND act10_repr_account_cd = act13_repr_account_cd) LEFT OUTER JOIN act01_account_code ON (act01_company_id = act13_company_id AND act01_account_cd = act13_real_account_cd) WHERE act13_company_id = #{companyId} AND concat(act13_repr_account_cd, act10_repr_account_nm, act13_account_map, act13_real_account_cd , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||act01_account_nm , upper(act13_note)) LIKE upper(#{searchText}) ORDER BY act13_repr_account_cd, act13_account_map

SELECT FROM act13_real_account_map LEFT OUTER JOIN act10_repr_account ON (act10_company_id = act13_company_id AND act10_repr_account_cd = act13_repr_account_cd) LEFT OUTER JOIN act01_account_code ON (act01_company_id = act13_company_id AND act01_account_cd = act13_real_account_cd) WHERE act13_real_account_map_id = #{realAccountMapId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO act13_real_account_map (act13_real_account_map_id, act13_company_id, act13_repr_account_cd, act13_account_map, act13_real_account_cd, act13_note) VALUES (#{realAccountMapId}, #{companyId}, #{req.reprAccountCode}, #{req.accountMap}, #{req.realAccountCode}, #{req.note})

INSERT INTO act13_real_account_map (act13_real_account_map_id, act13_company_id, act13_repr_account_cd, act13_account_map, act13_real_account_cd, act13_note) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{companyId} , act13_repr_account_cd , act13_account_map , act13_real_account_cd , act13_note FROM act13_real_account_map WHERE act13_company_id = 0 AND act13_repr_account_cd = #{reprAccountCode} AND act13_account_map = #{accountMap}
